english.title: Interfere with access to / provision of abortion services
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), when within a safe access zone for an abortion clinic, namely **(..SPECIFY CLINIC..), did an act, namely **(..SPECIFY ACT..), intending that, or being reckless as to whether, it had the effect of

(A)_[influencing any person’s decision to access, provide or facilitate the provision of abortion services at an abortion clinic]_
(B)_[obstructing or impeding any person accessing, providing, or facilitating the provision of abortion services at an abortion clinic]_
(C)_[causing harassment, alarm or distress to any person in connection with a decision to access, provide, or facilitate the provision of abortion services at an abortion clinic]_
(D)_[**(..SPECIFY COMBINATION OF ABOVE..)]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 9(1) and (3) of the Public Order Act 2023.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
within a safe access zone
did an act recklessly / with intent to have the effect of
influencing any person's decision to access / provide / facilitate the provision of abortion services at an abortion clinic
whilst they were within the safe access zone for the clinic

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: The offence is not made out where a person inside a dwelling where the person affected is also in that or another dwelling, or a person inside a building or site used as a place of worship where the person affected is also in that building or site (section 9(3)).
